extracted.name: My Chicken Chile Pepper Stew
extracted.description: Cold months are on the rise here in Oklahoma. Nothing better than breaking out your Crock-Pot. My Chicken Chile Pepper Stew, is just the ticket to warm you up from the inside out. Full of flavor and peppers. Your taste buds are sure going to love you!
ingredient_lines: 1 lb boneless chicken thighs cut in ½ inch pieces
1 lb yellow golden potatoes cut lengthwise, then crosswise
3 small bell peppers, cut ½ inch pieces (I used all colors.)
1 jalapeno pepper seeded and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Place chicken, potatoes, onion, bell peppers, jalapeno and garlic in crock pot.

Stir together broth, tomatoes, chili powder, and oregano in large bowl. Pour broth mixture and add your worcestershire sauce over chicken mixture in crock pot. Mix well. Cook on low for 8 to 9 hours. Top with sour cream, corn bread croutons, cheese or crisp cheese bites or corn relish.
